47989.meaning1: might is right; there is benefit in being strong
47989.commentary: (ANa) bal'attho iti'pī'ti balena me attho iti'pi, bale vā ṭhito'mhī'ti'pi vadati.

examples.text: yadapi, bhikkhave, lobho tadapi akusalamūlaṃ, yadapi luddho abhisaṅkharoti kāyena vācāya manasā tadapi akusalaṃ, yadapi luddho lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto parassa asatā dukkhaṃ uppādayati vadhena vā bandhanena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā pabbājanāya vā balav'amhi bal'attho iti'pi tadapi akusalaṃ.

bahū tattha hatthikāyā assakāyā rathakāyā pattikāyā, bahu tattha dantājinaṃ, bahu tattha hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ akatañ'c'eva katañ'ca, bahu tattha itthipariggaho. sakkā ca tāvataken'eva bal'atthena abhivijinituṃ. abhivijina, mahārājā'ti, kin'ti naṃ kareyyāsī'ti?
kiṃdado balado hoti, kiṃdado hoti vaṇṇado, kiṃdado sukhado hoti, kiṃdado hoti cakkhudo, ko ca sabbadado hoti, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito'ti.
annado balado hoti, vatthado hoti vaṇṇado, yānado sukhado hoti, dīpado hoti cakkhudo.
so āyudāyī baladāyī, sukhaṃ vaṇṇaṃ dado naro, dīgh'āyu yasavā hoti, yattha yatth'ūpapajjatī'ti.

47994.meaning2: come into power; grown strong; lit. reaching power

examples.text: sabb'eva nikkhipissanti, bhūtā loke samussayaṃ, etādiso satthā, loke appaṭipuggalo, tathāgato balappatto, sambuddho parinibbuto'ti.

47995.meaning1: size of army; amount of military force

examples.text: bahū tattha hatthikāyā assakāyā rathakāyā pattikāyā, bahu tattha dhanadhaññaṃ, bahu tattha hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ akatañ'c'eva katañ'ca, bahu tattha itthipariggaho. sakkā ca tāvataken'eva balamattena abhivijinituṃ. abhivijina, mahārājā'ti, kin'ti naṃ kareyyāsī'ti?

47996.commentary: (MNa) balamattā'ti balam'eva, balañ'c'assa kāye na bhaveyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: cirapaṭik'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitu'kāmo, n'atthi ca me kāyasmiṃ tāvatikā balamattā, yāvat'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyan'ti
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso ābādhiko assa dukkhito bāḷhagilāno, bhattañ'c'assa nacchādeyya, na c'assa kāye balamattā.

47997.commentary: (MNt) balarāsī'ti hatthi-ass'ādibalakāyo. tena daṇḍabhedāni vadati. bhedo'pi hi balavato eva ijjhati, sv'āyaṃ catubbidho'pi upāyayogena sampavattīyati.

examples.text: evaṃ mitta-santhav'ākāra-saṅkhāto vā, idaṃ sataṃ vā sahassaṃ vā gahetvā katip'āhaṃ āgamehī'ti evaṃ lañj'ānuppadāna-saṅkhāto vā, imin'āhaṃ balarāsinā paṭibāhissāmī'ti evaṃ balarāsisaṅkhāto vā saṅgaro n'atthi.

47998.meaning1: strong; powerful; mighty; endowed with strength
47998.synonym: ugga, thāmavant, balavant, balī, bhusa, mahatī, mahanta, mahantī

examples.text: yāsu kāsuci etāsu, danto jāyati puṅgavo, dhorayho balasampanno, kalyāṇajavanikkamo, tam'eva bhāre yuñjanti, n'āssa vaṇṇaṃ parikkhare.
